senses.gloss: m. (an adapt. of mille, sub. passuum)

units: <cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 6:4">Yoma VI, 4</cite> <he>שבעה ומחצה לכל מ׳</he> seven and a half Ris for each mile.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 6:1:7">Y. Shebi. VI, 36ᶜ</cite> top <he>י״ב מ׳ כמחנה ישראל</he> twelve mil, corresponding to the encampment of the Israelites (ref. to <cite ref="Numbers 33:8">Num. XXXIII, 8</cite>); a. fr.—Pl. <he>מִילִין</he>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Yoma 4:13">Tosef. Yoma IV</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Yoma 3:13">III</cite>), 13.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 907:5">Yalk. Deut. 907</cite> <he>מסילה שלא היה בה מ׳</he> a road on which there were no milestones.
